# Button

`ui.button` · parts: `Button` · elements: `<a>`, `<button>`

## Purpose

Button triggers an action. With `href` it renders an anchor (navigation that
looks like an action). Event handlers (onClick) flow through attrs/rest.

## Notes

<!-- ui8kit-docs:prose:start -->
- Use `href` for navigation that looks like an action; plain links use [Link](link.md).
- `disabled` on the anchor form becomes `aria-disabled="true"` + `tabindex="-1"` (anchors have no native disabled).
- Event handlers (`onClick`, `@click`, `on:click`) go through rest/attrs.
<!-- ui8kit-docs:prose:end -->

Button renders a button element, or an anchor when Href is set.
Type/Form apply only in button mode; Disabled on anchors uses aria-disabled.

## Props

| Canonical (templ, Jinja2) | React / Solid | HTML (Svelte, Vue, WC) | Type | Default | Kind | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Type` | `type` | `type` | `"button" \| "submit" \| "reset"` | — | prop | button type (default button) |
| `Form` | `form` | `form` | `string` | — | passthrough attr | associated form id (button mode) |
| `Href` | `href` | `href` | `string` | — | prop | renders an anchor when set |
| `Disabled` | `disabled` | `disabled` | `boolean` | — | prop | blocks interaction |
| `AriaLabel` | `aria-label` | `aria-label` | `string` | — | passthrough attr |  |
| `AriaPressed` | `aria-pressed` | `aria-pressed` | `string` | — | passthrough attr |  |
| `AriaExpanded` | `aria-expanded` | `aria-expanded` | `string` | — | passthrough attr |  |
| `AriaControls` | `aria-controls` | `aria-controls` | `string` | — | passthrough attr |  |

Also accepts: `class` (`className` in React), extra attributes (rest props in JS runtimes, `Attrs` in templ/Jinja2, `attrs` in Twig/Latte; caller wins), children.

## Variants

_No variants: the primitive ships no visual classes; style it with token classes via `class`._

## Children

Accepts children (default slot / `children` / `{ children... }` / trusted HTML string in Twig, Latte, Jinja2 — see [runtimes](../runtimes/)). Void tags selected via `tag` render no children.

## ARIA

- Computed/forwarded: `aria-label`, `aria-pressed`, `aria-expanded`, `aria-controls`, `aria-disabled` (omitted when empty).
- Typed ARIA props: `aria-label`, `aria-pressed`, `aria-expanded`, `aria-controls` — static values only.

## Classes escape hatch

Compose the part's classes without rendering it (custom root element, no asChild outside React):

| Runtime | Helper |
| --- | --- |
| React / Solid / Vue / Svelte / WC | `buttonClasses({ ... })` from `button/button.shared.ts` |
| templ | `button.ButtonClasses(button.ButtonProps{...})` |
| Twig | `ui8kit_classes('buttonClasses', { class: '…' })` |
| Latte | `\UI8Kit\Latte\Classes::buttonClasses(['class' => '…'])` |
| Jinja2 | `button_classes(p)` |

React additionally supports `asChild` (merges props onto the single child via [Slot](slot.md)).

## Rendered DOM per state

Canonical renderer output (children = `Content`); all 9 runtimes are parity-tested to produce this DOM.

| State | Props | HTML |
| --- | --- | --- |
| defaults | — | `<button type="button">Content</button>` |
| submit | `{"Type":"submit","Class":"bg-primary text-primary-foreground"}` | `<button type="submit" class="bg-primary text-primary-foreground">Content</button>` |
| disabled | `{"Disabled":true}` | `<button type="button" disabled>Content</button>` |
| form | `{"Form":"f1","AriaLabel":"Save"}` | `<button type="button" form="f1" aria-label="Save">Content</button>` |
| pressed | `{"AriaPressed":"true","AriaExpanded":"false","AriaControls":"m1"}` | `<button type="button" aria-pressed="true" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="m1">Content</button>` |
| href | `{"Href":"/docs","Class":"underline"}` | `<a href="/docs" class="underline">Content</a>` |
| hrefDisabled | `{"Href":"/x","Disabled":true}` | `<a href="/x" aria-disabled="true" tabindex="-1">Content</a>` |
| Type=button | `{"Type":"button"}` | `<button type="button">Content</button>` |
| Type=submit | `{"Type":"submit"}` | `<button type="submit">Content</button>` |
| Type=reset | `{"Type":"reset"}` | `<button type="reset">Content</button>` |
| Disabled | `{"Disabled":true}` | `<button type="button" disabled>Content</button>` |

## Usage

Fixture `submit` (`{"Type":"submit","Class":"bg-primary text-primary-foreground"}`) — every snippet renders:

```html
<button type="submit" class="bg-primary text-primary-foreground">Content</button>
```

**React** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/react.md))

```tsx
import { Button } from "./ui/button/button";

<Button type="submit" className="bg-primary text-primary-foreground">Content</Button>
```

**Vue 3** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/vue.md))

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import Button from "./ui/button/Button.vue";
</script>

<template>
  <Button type="submit" class="bg-primary text-primary-foreground">Content</Button>
</template>
```
